arguments.command:
python -c "
from more_itertools import (
    combination_with_replacement_index,
    sum_of_squares,
    nth_combination_with_replacement,
    relative_seek,
    seekable,
    polynomial_eval,
    polynomial_derivative,
)

# Test combination_with_replacement_index
print('Testing combination_with_replacement_index...')
assert combination_with_replacement_index('AA', 'ABC') == 0
assert combination_with_replacement_index('AC', 'ABC') == 2
assert combination_with_replacement_index('CC', 'ABC') == 5
print('OK')

# Test sum_of_squares
print('Testing sum_of_squares...')
assert sum_of_squares([2, 3, 4]) == 29
print('OK')

# Test nth_combination_with_replacement
print('Testing nth_combination_with_replacement...')
assert nth_combination_with_replacement('ABCD', 2, 3) == ('B', 'B')
print('OK')

# Test relative_seek
print('Testing relative_seek...')
it = seekable('abcdef')
next(it), next(it), next(it)
relative_seek(it, 1)
assert next(it) == 'd'
relative_seek(it, -3)
assert next(it) == 'a'
print('OK')

# Test polynomial_eval
print('Testing polynomial_eval...')
assert polynomial_eval([1, -4, -17, 60], 5) == 0
assert polynomial_eval([1, 0, -1], 3) == 8
print('OK')

# Test polynomial_derivative
print('Testing polynomial_derivative...')
assert polynomial_derivative([1, -4, -17, 60]) == [-4, -34, 180]
print('OK')

print('All manual tests passed!')
"
